bands.label: Developing
bands.blurb: Real signal across most facets with visible, nameable gaps.

providers.name: Advance Auto Parts
providers.description: Advance Auto Parts is a leading automotive aftermarket parts retailer offering a comprehensive catalog of automotive parts, accessories, batteries, and maintenance items. The company serves both professional automotive technicians and do-it-yourself customers across North America through retail stores, online, and commercial delivery programs.

providers.name: Wayfair
providers.description: Wayfair Inc. is one of the world's largest online destinations for home goods and furniture, serving over 20 million customers and 10,000+ suppliers. Wayfair's Developer Portal provides GraphQL-based APIs enabling suppliers to manage purchase orders, inventory updates, product catalog management, advanced shipment notifications, and returns. The platform is built on federated GraphQL architecture using domain-oriented microservices, allowing suppliers to request only the data they need.

providers.name: BJ's Wholesale Club
providers.description: BJ's Wholesale Club is a leading operator of membership warehouse clubs concentrated primarily on the eastern half of the United States. BJ's offers its members significant savings on a wide assortment of merchandise, including fresh foods, groceries, household essentials, and general merchandise. The company operates over 230 clubs and is focused on digital transformation, offering APIs to partners for product data, inventory, pricing, and order management integrations.

providers.name: Walmart
providers.description: Walmart is a multinational retail corporation that operates a chain of hypermarkets, discount department stores, and grocery stores. The company is known for offering a wide range of products at competitive prices, attracting customers from all walks of life. Walmart also provides various convenience services, such as pharmacy, optical, and financial services, making it a one-stop shop for many consumers. The Walmart Marketplace APIs enable third-party sellers to list and sell products, manage orders, inventory, pricing, fulfillment, and reporting on Walmart.com.

providers.name: Target
providers.description: Target Corporation is one of the largest retailers in the United States, offering a wide assortment of general merchandise and food through more than 1,900 stores and digital channels. Target's technology platform powers partner integrations, internal services, and open-source tooling across their retail operations.

providers.name: Walgreens
providers.description: Walgreens is one of the largest pharmacy-led health and wellbeing companies in the United States, operating over 8,000 locations nationwide. The Walgreens Developer Program provides APIs enabling third-party applications to integrate pharmacy prescription management, vaccine scheduling, retail shopping, store locations, and product inventory. The APIs support seamless healthcare delivery, prescription refills, immunization appointments, and retail e-commerce integrations for mobile and web applications.

bands.label: Thin
bands.blurb: Limited machine-readable signal beyond documentation a human can read.

providers.name: Albertsons
providers.description: Albertsons Companies is one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States, operating supermarkets and pharmacies under banners including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco, Acme, Shaw's, Star Market, and others. The company operates the Albertsons Media Collective, a retail media network that provides advertisers API access to near-real-time campaign performance data and audience targeting capabilities based on shopper purchase behavior across its banner network.

providers.name: Urban Outfitters
providers.description: Urban Outfitters is a multi-channel lifestyle retailer offering an eclectic mix of women's, men's, and kids apparel, footwear, accessories, beauty, and home goods. Part of URBN, Inc. (which also owns Anthropologie, Free People, Bhldn, and Nuuly), Urban Outfitters operates stores in the US, Europe, and Canada alongside a robust ecommerce platform. The brand provides affiliate marketing integration through the Rakuten Advertising network and a third-party seller marketplace program (UO MRKT) that accepts independent brands selling through EDI and third-party integration platforms. Urban Outfitters uses Stripe for payment processing, Stripe Connect for marketplace seller payouts, and Stripe Terminal for in-store payments.

providers.name: Lowe's
providers.description: Lowe's Companies, Inc. is an American retail company specializing in home improvement. Lowe's operates a developer portal built on Microsoft Azure API Management that provides partners and developers access to product, inventory, pricing, and store APIs for integration with Lowe's retail operations. Discover APIs, learn how to use them, try them out interactively, and sign up to acquire keys.

providers.name: IKEA
providers.description: A Swedish multinational furniture and home goods retailer known for its affordable, ready-to-assemble products. Operates hundreds of stores worldwide and is the world's largest furniture retailer with a distinctive showroom-based shopping experience. IKEA does not publish an official public developer API or developer portal; the surfaces profiled here are community reverse-engineered specs of the IKEA storefront (Product Catalog, Search, Sales Item availability, After Purchase Ordering / spare parts) plus the local-network API of the DIRIGERA smart home hub. All artifacts are community-built and unofficial — they may change at any time and are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by IKEA.

providers.name: Home Depot
providers.description: The Home Depot is the world's largest home improvement retailer, offering tools, construction products, appliances, and services through stores, websites, and apps in the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

providers.name: Skechers U.S.A.
providers.description: Skechers U.S.A. is an American lifestyle and performance footwear company (Fortune 500) that designs, develops, and markets a diverse range of footwear for men, women, and children across 170+ countries. Skechers operates direct-to-consumer digital commerce through its website and mobile app, wholesale partnerships with retailers, and a global network of owned and franchised retail stores. Their digital commerce infrastructure relies on e-commerce APIs for product catalog management, inventory, order management, customer accounts, and loyalty programs.

bands.label: Emerging
bands.blurb: More than an index entry but still mostly links rather than artifacts.

providers.name: Sally Beauty Holdings
providers.description: Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc. is a leading international specialty retailer and distributor of professional beauty supplies. Operates through two segments: Sally Beauty Supply (consumer-facing beauty retail) and Beauty Systems Group (BSG, professional-only distribution). The company serves salon professionals, colorists, and beauty enthusiasts with over 4,800 stores globally.

providers.name: Ross Stores
providers.description: Ross Stores, Inc. (NASDAQ: ROST) is the largest off-price apparel and home fashion retailer in the United States, operating over 1,700 Ross Dress for Less and 320+ dd's DISCOUNTS stores across 43 states, the District of Columbia, and Guam. The company sources a broad assortment of in-season, name-brand merchandise at deep discounts (20-60% below department and specialty store prices) through opportunistic buying. Ross operates a highly efficient supply chain powered by AI-driven inventory management, distribution automation, and integrated supplier and partner technology platforms.

providers.name: Weis Markets
providers.description: Weis Markets is a regional supermarket chain operating grocery stores in the mid-Atlantic United States, with 197 store locations across Pennsylvania, Maryland, Delaware, New Jersey, New York, Virginia, and West Virginia. The company operates a digital commerce platform, loyalty rewards program (Weis Rewards), mobile app, and vendor/supplier integration ecosystem using EDI and supply chain APIs. Weis Markets uses Toshiba ELERA commerce platform for unified in-store and online commerce.

providers.name: Walgreens Boots Alliance
providers.description: Walgreens Boots Alliance (WBA) is a global pharmacy-led health and wellbeing enterprise operating in more than 25 countries, with pharmacy chains Walgreens in the US and Boots in the UK, pharmaceutical wholesale and distribution through Alliance Healthcare, and specialty pharmacy operations. WBA operates as a Fortune 100 company and global healthcare platform, leveraging data science, AI, and digital health technologies to serve patients, customers, and health systems. While WBA's primary developer APIs are offered through the Walgreens Developer Program, the enterprise also uses healthcare data platforms for population health management, specialty pharmacy integration, and digital health services.

providers.name: CarMax
providers.description: CarMax (NYSE: KMX) is the largest retailer of used cars in the United States, operating an omnichannel business that spans brick-and-mortar stores, carmax.com online purchasing, home delivery, financing, appraisals, and trade-ins. CarMax does not publish a public developer portal, but its engineering organization operates an extensive internal API program built around distinct API roles (Data Access Layer, Business Logic Layer, Server-Driven UI, Backend for Frontend). Public-facing APIs documented by the CarMax Engineering Blog include a Store Locations API and a Vehicle Inventory API, and CarMax has publicly discussed a Server-Driven UI API that controls vehicle search filters across web and mobile. Partner and syndication integrations are handled case by case rather than through a self-service portal.

providers.name: Aéropostale
providers.description: An American specialty retailer offering on-trend apparel, accessories, and personal care products targeted at teens and young adults. Operates stores across the United States and internationally through franchise partnerships.

providers.name: Pool
providers.description: Pool.com is a Web3 domain service provider offering Infinity Domains, enabling ICANN-accredited registrars and other partners to mint and distribute Second Level Domains and integrate Web3 naming into their services through Pool's registrar API.

providers.name: 7-Eleven
providers.description: A global convenience store chain offering everyday essentials, snacks, and beverages. Known for its 24/7 operations and Slurpee brand drinks.

providers.name: TJX Companies
providers.description: The TJX Companies, Inc. is an American multinational off-price department store corporation headquartered in Framingham, Massachusetts, ranked No. 80 on the 2024 Fortune 500 list. Operating over 4,800 stores across nine countries and three continents under brands including T.J. Maxx, Marshalls, HomeGoods, Sierra, HomeSense (US), and Winners, HomeSense, Marshalls (Canada), TJX provides supplier and vendor integration through EDI and web-based portal platforms. Supplier connectivity is handled via Oracle iSupplier, SupplierOne, and the DiCentral ASN Vendor Portal, supporting purchase orders, advanced shipping notices, invoicing, and payment tracking.

providers.name: Delek US Holdings
providers.description: Delek US Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: DK) is a diversified downstream energy company headquartered in Brentwood, Tennessee with assets in petroleum refining, logistics, asphalt operations, renewable fuels, and convenience store retailing. Delek operates four refineries in Tyler and Big Spring (Texas), El Dorado (Arkansas), and Krotz Springs (Louisiana) with combined crude throughput capacity of roughly 302,000 barrels per day. Logistics assets are operated through Delek Logistics Partners (NYSE: DKL). The company provides investor relations and ESG reporting on its public website but does not publish a developer API; partner integrations occur through industry-standard EDI, terminal automation, and ticketing systems.

providers.name: Simon Property Group
providers.description: Simon Property Group is the largest retail real estate investment trust (REIT) in the United States, owning, developing, and managing premier shopping, dining, entertainment, and mixed-use destinations. Simon's portfolio includes an interest in 254 properties: traditional malls, premium outlets, Mills centers, lifestyle centers, and other retail properties in North America, Europe, and Asia. The company operates ShopSimon, an e-commerce platform, and Simon Innovation Group to advance retail technology innovation. Simon had trailing twelve-month revenue of approximately $6.36 billion as of 2025 and a market capitalization of approximately $67 billion.

providers.name: AutoZone
providers.description: AutoZone is the nation's leading retailer and a leading distributor of automotive replacement parts and accessories with more than 7,000 stores across the Americas. AutoZone serves both do-it-yourself (DIY) customers and professional automotive service providers (DIFM) through retail stores, e-commerce, and electronic ordering integrations for commercial accounts via AutoZone Pro.

providers.name: LVMH
providers.description: LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton is the world's largest luxury goods conglomerate, headquartered in Paris and operating over 75 prestigious brands. Its portfolio spans fashion and leather goods (Louis Vuitton, Christian Dior, Fendi, Loewe, Celine), wines and spirits (Moët & Chandon, Hennessy, Veuve Clicquot), perfumes and cosmetics (Givenchy, Guerlain), watches and jewelry (Tiffany & Co., Bulgari, TAG Heuer), and selective retailing (Sephora, DFS). LVMH does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal at the group level; technical and partner integrations are handled brand-by-brand and through closed innovation partnerships such as the Aura Blockchain Consortium.

providers.name: Kroger
providers.description: Partner APIs related to integrating with a full-service delivery partner.

providers.name: Fortune Brands Innovations
providers.description: Fortune Brands Innovations is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Fortune Brands Innovations API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Dollar Tree
providers.description: Dollar Tree is a leading operator of discount variety stores in North America, operating more than 16,000 stores under the Dollar Tree and Family Dollar banners. Vendor and supplier integration is primarily handled through EDI, SAP, and ERP systems via the Dollar Tree Vendor Portal. No public REST API is currently available.

providers.name: Tapestry
providers.description: Tapestry is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Tapestry API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: Abercrombie and Fitch
providers.description: Abercrombie & Fitch is a global specialty retailer of casual apparel, accessories, and personal care products operating multiple lifestyle brands including Abercrombie, Hollister, and Gilly Hicks. The company operates through a direct-to-consumer model with both e-commerce and physical retail stores across global markets.

providers.name: Barnes & Noble
providers.description: Barnes & Noble is the largest retail bookseller in the United States and the operator of the Nook digital reading platform. Barnes & Noble does not currently publish a public general-purpose developer portal. Trade and affiliate partners integrate through B&N's affiliate program, the B&N Press self-publishing platform for independent authors, EDI-based wholesale channels with publishers, and the Nook content distribution and reading ecosystem.

providers.name: Ulta Beauty
providers.description: Ulta Beauty is the largest beauty retailer in the United States, offering cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products, and salon services through retail stores and online. The company operates over 1,400 stores across all 50 states and an e-commerce platform. Ulta Beauty does not currently offer a public developer API, but provides an affiliate program through Impact for publishers and content creators.

providers.name: Sprouts Farmers Market
providers.description: Sprouts Farmers Market is a specialty grocery retailer focused on fresh, natural, and organic foods at affordable prices. Operating primarily in the western United States, Sprouts integrates with third-party platforms including Instacart, DoorDash, and Uber Eats for online grocery delivery. Sprouts uses EDI-based supply chain integrations and participates in Instacart's AI-powered Cart Assistant program. There is no public developer API; integrations are handled through EDI and third-party delivery platform partnerships.

providers.name: Circle K
providers.description: Circle K is a global convenience store and fuel station chain operating more than 14,800 stores worldwide including 9,799 locations in North America and 2,697 in Europe across 48 U.S. states and over 30 countries. A subsidiary of Alimentation Couche-Tard, Circle K operates the Inner Circle Rewards loyalty program, the Easy Pay fuel payment system, an EV charging network, and the Circle K PRO Business Fleet Card.

providers.name: Carter's
providers.description: Carter's, Inc. is the largest branded marketer of young children's apparel in the United States, operating the Carter's, OshKosh B'gosh, and Skip Hop brands. Its customer-facing digital surface includes carters.com and carters.com/cart e-commerce, mobile apps, a rewards program, and vendor / supply-chain integrations, but no public developer API or partner program is currently published.

providers.name: Bloomingdale's
providers.description: Bloomingdale's is an American luxury department store chain and a subsidiary of Macy's, Inc. Bloomingdale's does not publish a public developer portal; partner integration is delivered through the parent Macy's Inc. vendor and trade partner programs, drop-ship and EDI channels with suppliers, the Bloomingdale's affiliate program for marketing partners, and the shared Macy's Inc. technology platform powering Bloomingdale's commerce, loyalty, and fulfillment.

providers.name: Burlington Stores
providers.description: Burlington Stores is an American national off-price department store retailer offering brand-name clothing, footwear, accessories, home decor, and more at everyday low prices. Explore a wide selection of high-quality, brand-name clothing, home decor, and more at unbeatable prices at Burlington.

providers.name: Ralph Lauren
providers.description: Ralph Lauren is a global leader in the design, marketing, and distribution of premium lifestyle products across apparel, footwear, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. The company operates ralphlauren.com, Polo Ralph Lauren, Lauren, Club Monaco, and other brands. No public developer API has been verified; the company participates in affiliate programs via Rakuten and Sovrn Commerce, and uses Microsoft Azure OpenAI for the Ask Ralph AI shopping assistant launched in 2025.

providers.name: Casey's General Stores
providers.description: Casey's General Stores is one of the largest convenience store chains in the United States, operating more than 2,900 stores selling fuel, made-from-scratch pizza, prepared food, and other convenience items primarily in small midwestern communities. Casey's is a publicly traded Fortune 500 company (NASDAQ: CASY) and offers a mobile app for pizza ordering, delivery, and its Casey's Rewards loyalty program. No public developer APIs have been documented; partner and supplier integrations are managed privately.

providers.name: Kontoor Brands
providers.description: Kontoor Brands, Inc. is a global lifestyle apparel company with a portfolio of iconic denim and casual apparel brands including Wrangler, Lee, and Rock & Republic. Headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina, the company designs, manufactures, sources, markets, and distributes its apparel products worldwide through wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels. Kontoor Brands does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal.

providers.name: CrossAmerica Partners
providers.description: CrossAmerica Partners is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The CrossAmerica Partners API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: ARKO Corp
providers.description: ARKO Corp (Nasdaq: ARKO) is a Fortune 500 company and one of the largest operators of convenience stores and wholesalers of fuel in the United States. Through its subsidiary GPM Investments, ARKO operates approximately 1,400 company-operated stores under 25+ regional brands across 30+ states, as well as proprietary cardlock locations and a fleet fueling network. In 2026, ARKO completed the IPO of ARKO Petroleum Corp., which operates its wholesale, fleet fueling, and petroleum distribution segments.

providers.name: VF Corporation
providers.description: VF Corporation is a global apparel and footwear company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. VF owns major brands including Vans, The North Face, Timberland, Altra, Eastpak, Icebreaker, JanSport, Kipling, Napapijri, and Smartwool. The company does not offer a public developer API program; its technology integrations are handled through third-party e-commerce platforms and enterprise supply chain systems. VF Corporation operates more than 1,500 stores globally and integrates with platforms such as Shopify, Amazon, Magento, WooCommerce, and BigCommerce via third-party integration services.

providers.name: Costco Wholesale
providers.description: Costco Wholesale Corporation is a Fortune 500 American multinational membership-only big-box retail chain that operates warehouse clubs offering a wide selection of merchandise at discounted prices. Costco does not publish a public developer API; supplier and trading partner integrations are conducted through EDI and B2B channels using ANSI X12 transactions and the Costco Supplier Portal. Costco operates an e-commerce site, the Costco Travel and Costco Pharmacy properties, and the Costco Photo Center.

providers.name: American Eagle Outfitters
providers.description: American Eagle Outfitters (AEO) is a global specialty retailer operating the American Eagle and Aerie brands, offering on-trend clothing, accessories, and personal care products at affordable prices. The company operates over 1,000 stores across the Americas and online, with a unified commerce strategy spanning e-commerce, mobile, and in-store experiences.

providers.name: Sephora
providers.description: Sephora is a French multinational chain of personal care and beauty stores and a subsidiary of LVMH, operating 2,700+ locations worldwide and a large ecommerce footprint. Sephora does not publish a public developer API and does not maintain a public GitHub organization. The Sephora storefront and Beauty Insider loyalty program are accessed only through consumer apps and the website; affiliate marketing partnerships are brokered through third-party networks such as Rakuten Advertising and Skimlinks rather than a Sephora-owned API.

providers.name: Global Partners LP
providers.description: Global Partners LP is a leading independent owner, supplier, and operator of liquid energy terminals, fueling locations, and retail experiences. The company distributes gasoline, distillates, residual oil, renewable fuels, crude oil, and propane across the Northeast United States through an integrated network of terminals, gas stations, and convenience stores.

providers.name: Foot Locker
providers.description: Foot Locker is a global retailer of athletic footwear and apparel, operating stores under banners including Foot Locker, Kids Foot Locker, Lady Foot Locker, Champs Sports, Eastbay, and Footaction. Foot Locker does not publish a public developer portal or open API. Integrations with Foot Locker (loyalty, gift cards, retail media, e-commerce affiliate, supplier EDI) are arranged through partner programs and require commercial agreements.

providers.name: Publix Super Markets
providers.description: Publix Super Markets is one of the largest employee-owned supermarket chains in the United States, headquartered in Lakeland, Florida. It operates grocery stores, pharmacies, delivery, catering, and online ordering services across the southeastern United States. Publix is a Fortune 500 company. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Wawa
providers.description: Wawa is a privately held, family-owned convenience store and fuel retail chain headquartered in Pennsylvania. Founded in 1803 as a dairy farm and operating convenience stores since 1964, Wawa runs approximately 1,100 stores across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, Florida, North Carolina, Indiana, and Alabama. The company is a regional fresh-food, beverage, and fuel brand with a strong loyalty program (Wawa Rewards) and a mobile ordering app. Wawa operates an internal API management platform (built with MuleSoft) used to connect to third-party services such as Uber Eats, Grubhub, and DoorDash for delivery, but does not publish a public developer portal or expose public APIs.

providers.name: Williams-Sonoma
providers.description: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500 American publicly traded retail company specializing in kitchenware and home furnishings. It is one of the largest e-commerce retailers in the United States. The company operates multiple brands including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, PBteen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark and Graham, and Green Row. Williams-Sonoma does not offer a public developer API. The company uses internal APIs and third-party platforms for e-commerce, registry services, and supply chain management.

providers.name: Nordstrom
providers.description: Nordstrom is a leading fashion retailer offering compelling clothing, shoes, and accessories for men, women, and children through Nordstrom and Nordstrom Rack stores and online. Nordstrom does not currently operate a public developer portal or expose general-purpose APIs to third-party developers; this repository captures the company profile and any future developer-facing artifacts.

providers.name: Vontier
providers.description: Vontier is a global mobility technology company serving convenience stores, fleet operators, and auto repair shops. Its portfolio spans traditional fueling, alternative energy (EV, CNG, RNG), repair tools, and car-wash technology through brands including Gilbarco, DRB, Driivz, Matco Tools, Teletrac Navman, ANGI Energy, and Invenco.

providers.name: Boise Cascade
providers.description: Boise Cascade is a leading North American manufacturer and distributor of building materials for the residential and commercial construction industry. The company produces engineered wood products (EWP) including I-joists, LVL beams, and glulam, as well as structural panels and lumber, and distributes a broad range of building materials through its wholesale distribution network.

providers.name: Big Lots
providers.description: Big Lots is a discount retailer offering a wide assortment of brand-name closeout merchandise including furniture, food, consumables, seasonal products, soft home, hard home, and electronics. Big Lots operated hundreds of stores across the United States. In 2024, Big Lots filed for bankruptcy and its brand and operations were acquired by Nexus Capital Management.

providers.name: Caleres
providers.description: Caleres is an American footwear company headquartered in Clayton, Missouri, established in 1878 (rebranded from Brown Shoe Company in 2015). It designs, develops, sources, manufactures, and distributes footwear through its Famous Footwear retail segment (approximately 900 U.S. locations) and Brand Portfolio segment which includes Sam Edelman, Stuart Weitzman, Allen Edmonds, Naturalizer, Vionic, LifeStride, Dr. Scholl's, Rykä, Franco Sarto, and Blowfish Malibu. Caleres does not currently publish a public developer API program; integrations are typically handled through B2B EDI and partner channels.

providers.name: Dillard's
providers.description: Dillard's is an American department store chain offering apparel, footwear, cosmetics, handbags, menswear, and home goods from top brands. The retailer operates stores across the United States and an e-commerce site, with no publicly documented developer APIs at this time.

providers.name: L Brands
providers.description: L Brands was a Fortune 500 specialty retail holding company best known for Victoria's Secret, PINK, and Bath & Body Works. In 2021 the company split into two independent publicly traded companies, with Bath & Body Works, Inc. retaining the original NYSE listing and Victoria's Secret & Co. spun off as a standalone retailer. The L Brands brand is no longer in active use; this repository preserves the historical corporate record. No public developer API has been documented.

providers.name: Levi Strauss
providers.description: Levi Strauss & Co. is one of the world's largest brand-name apparel companies and a global leader in jeanswear, designing and marketing jeans, casual wear, and related accessories under the Levi's, Dockers, Signature, and Denizen brands. The company does not publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: Tractor Supply
providers.description: Tractor Supply Company is the largest rural lifestyle retailer in the United States, providing products to support recreational farming, ranching, and country lifestyles. Tractor Supply integrates with suppliers and vendors via EDI and vendor portal systems, enabling order management, invoice processing, and shipment notifications. The company operates through its vendor transaction portal for supplier collaboration and EDI-based supply chain integrations.

providers.name: Dick's Sporting Goods
providers.description: Dick's Sporting Goods is a leading omni-channel sporting goods retailer offering an extensive assortment of authentic, high-quality sports equipment, apparel, footwear, and accessories. As a Fortune 500 retailer, Dick's Sporting Goods does not currently publish a public developer portal or APIs; this repository is maintained as a placeholder for any APIs, developer tools, or machine-readable artifacts that may emerge.

providers.name: Gap
providers.description: Gap Inc. is a Fortune 500 American clothing and accessories retailer operating brands including Gap, Old Navy, Banana Republic, and Athleta. Gap does not publish a public developer API; this repository tracks the company, its public web presence, and any partner or technical artifacts that surface over time.

providers.name: Inditex
providers.description: A Spanish multinational fashion group and the world's largest apparel retailer operating brands including Zara, Massimo Dutti, and Pull&Bear. Known for its fast-fashion model with rapid design-to-store turnaround times. No public developer portal or open API catalogue was located on inditex.com.

providers.name: Macy's
providers.description: Macy's, Inc. is one of the nation's premier omnichannel retailers, operating department stores, websites, and apps under the Macy's, Bloomingdale's, and Bluemercury brands. This repository tracks any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts that are made publicly available by Macy's.

providers.name: Builders FirstSource
providers.description: Builders FirstSource (NYSE: BLDR) is the nation's largest supplier and manufacturer of structural building products, value-added components, and construction services to the professional market for single-family and multi-family construction. The company operates approximately 570 locations across 43 states with 28,000 team members, headquartered in Irving, Texas. Its product portfolio includes lumber, manufactured components, doors, windows, millwork, cabinets, and roofing, complemented by digital procurement and project management tools through the myBLDR platform.

providers.name: H&M
providers.description: A Swedish multinational fast-fashion retailer offering affordable clothing, accessories, and home goods. Operates thousands of stores globally and is one of the world's largest fashion companies. No public developer portal or open API catalogue was located on hm.com or hmgroup.com.

providers.name: Academy Sports and Outdoors
providers.description: Academy Sports + Outdoors is a Fortune 500 sporting goods and outdoor recreation retailer headquartered in Katy, Texas. The company operates retail stores across the United States and an e-commerce platform offering sporting equipment, apparel, footwear, hunting and fishing gear, camping supplies, and outdoor recreation products. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with Academy Sports + Outdoors. No public developer APIs or documentation portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: TJX Companies
providers.description: The leading off-price retailer in the United States and worldwide operating TJ Maxx, Marshalls, HomeGoods, and Sierra. Sources brand-name and designer merchandise at discount prices through an opportunistic buying model.

providers.name: Dollar General
providers.description: Dollar General is a Fortune 500 discount retailer operating more than 20,000 stores across the United States. Vendor and supplier integration is handled through the DG Partners portal and RangeMe for new vendor onboarding. Dollar General does not currently publish a public REST API.

providers.name: G-III Apparel Group
providers.description: G-III Apparel Group is a designer, manufacturer, and marketer of branded apparel, accessories, and team sports products owning and licensing brands such as DKNY, Donna Karan, Calvin Klein, Tommy Hilfiger, and Karl Lagerfeld Paris.

providers.name: Guess
providers.description: Guess? is a global lifestyle brand that designs, markets, distributes, and licenses a leading lifestyle collection of contemporary apparel and accessories for men, women, and children.

providers.name: Ingles Markets
providers.description: Ingles Markets is a regional supermarket chain in the southeastern United States. The company operates retail grocery stores and provides store locator, weekly ad, and digital coupon experiences through its consumer website. No public developer API is currently published.

providers.name: O'Reilly Automotive
providers.description: O'Reilly Automotive is a Fortune 500 specialty retailer of automotive aftermarket parts, tools, supplies, equipment, and accessories serving both do-it-yourself customers and professional service providers. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for O'Reilly Automotive.

providers.name: PVH
providers.description: PVH Corp. is one of the largest apparel companies in the world, owning iconic brands including Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger and licensing brands such as Van Heusen, IZOD, and Arrow. This repository captures the APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for PVH.

providers.name: Trader Joe's
providers.description: An American chain of specialty grocery stores known for its unique private-label products, affordable prices, and quirky branding. Operates over 500 stores nationwide with a cult following for its curated selection of food and beverages.

providers.name: Tiffany & Co.
providers.description: An iconic American luxury jewelry and specialty retailer known for its diamond engagement rings and signature blue boxes. A subsidiary of LVMH operating flagship stores and boutiques in major cities around the world.

providers.name: Camping World Holdings
providers.description: Profile for Camping World Holdings in the API Evangelist network. Fortune F1000 (rank 555).

providers.name: Kohls
